author: m4
progressText: Yes, I am blocked. The Stripe webhook HMAC verification fails every time I use the SDK's built-in verifySignature method. The Stripe docs say to use the raw body buffer but the SDK wraps it before passing it through. Cannot verify incoming webhooks at all.
nextAction: Need James to pair on this — think it might be a middleware ordering issue.
blockerText: Stripe webhook HMAC verification: Stripe docs contradict SDK middleware behaviour.

author: m4
progressText: James and I are pairing on the HMAC issue. We've identified the problem: the Express bodyParser middleware is consuming the raw body before the Stripe SDK can read it. Working on the fix now.
nextAction: Apply raw-body preservation middleware config. Estimated fix: 4 hours.
blockerText: Express bodyParser consuming raw body before Stripe signature check.
